skills.name: stims-agent-api
skills.description: Drive or verify the Stims visualizer running in a browser tab — load presets, read engine state, run command-palette actions by stable id, and wait for conditions, using the URL flags and the window.__stims_agent in-page API. Use for browser automation, QA, or inspecting a playing preset's equation variables.

skills.name: stims-embed
skills.description: Embed the Stims MilkDrop visualizer in another page and drive it over postMessage. Use when a page needs to play a specific preset, restyle what is playing, set demo or microphone audio, or receive playback telemetry from an embedded toil.fyi iframe.
